Facts: Legatee sought payment of €40,000 legacy from heir; succession opened in Turin in 2017; claim filed in 2020.
Legal Framework: Articles 20, 22(1)(3), 38(1) Code of Civil Procedure regarding territorial jurisdiction in succession matters.
Interpretive Issue: Whether jurisdiction for legacy fulfillment claims filed beyond two years from succession opening follows special succession rules (Art. 22 CCP) or general obligation rules (Art. 20 CCP).
Legal Principle Applied: After expiration of the two-year period under Article 22 CCP, territorial jurisdiction reverts to Article 20 CCP (place of obligation's arising). The place where succession opens constitutes the place where the legacy obligation arises, regardless of legacy classification, as succession opening is the generative event of the obligation.
